info.title: LayerX public JSON-RPC
info.description: The merged Paxeer network is one execution domain in paxd, with EVM chain ID 125 (0x7d) and BFT block commitment as finality. Public node JSON-RPC is served at the root path of https://api-mainnet-beta.paxeer.network/ and https://api1.mainnet-beta.paxeer.network/ through https://api14.mainnet-beta.paxeer.network/. This OpenRPC document declares the hosted px_* methods and pax_sequencerReceipt; obtain hosted gateway coordinates and credentials from its operator. Hosted JSON-RPC uses JSON-RPC 2.0 POST / with Content-Type: application/json; authenticated route discovery uses GET /v1/routes at that gateway. Public node availability does not establish hosted px_* API deployment at public node URLs. The unified /rpc interface and its subtree are retired; there is no separate LayerX interface or execution router. Use native signed transactions and chain reads for network execution. The px_* methods provide registration, configured faucet access, account, balance, asset, history, consensus, receipt-key and capability reads, and authenticated route discovery, subject to each method's authentication and backend requirements. pax_sequencerReceipt relays the node receipt and commitment rung unchanged; submitted and receipted do not establish finality, which requires committed block evidence. Missing backend configuration or unavailable evidence produces an explicit refusal; balances, metadata, fees and finality are never fabricated.

methods.name: px_register

params.name: email_or_verification_token
params.description: An email address to begin signup, or the vfy_ token followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits to verify signup. Omit for direct principal registration.

methods.description: Creates one self-service identity principal in the beta tenant. The first two arguments are lowercase hexadecimal: a 32-byte Ed25519 signer public key and its 64-byte signature over SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-binding-v1", tenant, signer_public_key). The subject is derived as beta.<first 16 bytes of SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-subject-v1", tenant, signer_public_key)>, so registration is idempotent and cannot name another key holder's principal. Without the optional third argument the result is the identity principal record: tenant, sub, allowed_signer_public_keys, account and audiences. An email address starts signup and returns a pending result; a verification token completes signup and returns the identity session. Malformed arguments are -32602; a signature that does not prove possession of the named key is -32002; the per-minute self-registration budget is -32005; an unconfigured or unavailable identity service is -32001 with a machine-readable data.code.

methods.name: px_getCommit
methods.description: Reads the consensus commit at a positive decimal u64 height. Returns the decimal height and the consensus signed_header unchanged as signedHeader, including its header and commit. An unconfigured, unreachable or invalid consensus response is -32003 with data.code consensus_unavailable.

methods.name: px_getValidators
methods.description: Reads the full validator set at a positive decimal u64 height, collecting all consensus pages. Returns decimal-string height, total and votingPower; pubKey preserves the consensus pub_key object. An unconfigured, unreachable or inconsistent consensus response is -32003 with data.code consensus_unavailable.

methods.name: px_getReceiptKeys
methods.description: Publishes the configured pinned receipt signing keys and their inclusive height ranges. keyId and publicKey are 0x-prefixed 32-byte hexadecimal strings; firstHeight and lastHeight are JSON integers. Requires an explicit empty positional params array. An unconfigured list is -32003 with data.code receipt_keys_unavailable.

methods.name: px_getSequenceBatch
methods.description: Reads transaction 0 of the consensus block at a positive decimal u64 height. tx is the 0x-hex encoded MsgSequenceBatch transaction; proof contains total, index, leafHash and aunts for its Merkle inclusion under header.data_hash. The proof is verified before a result is served. A block without a MsgSequenceBatch at transaction 0 is -32602 with data.code no_sequence_batch; a proof mismatch is -32003 with data.code invalid_consensus_response.

methods.name: px_requestFunds
methods.description: Claims the authenticated identity principal's starter credit through the faucet claim path. Params are a DID and its bound, nonzero 32-byte lowercase hexadecimal Ed25519 signer public key without a 0x prefix. The bearer session must authorise the signer. The result includes funded, funding_id, transaction_id, decimal-string amount, network and the settled starter_credit record. Idempotency is bound to the principal and starter-credit grant, so retries reuse the grant. Incomplete funding evidence or an amount mismatch is -32603; pending claims are -32001 with data.code faucet_claim_pending. An unavailable identity backend is -32010 Kernel unavailable.

methods.name: pax_sequencerReceipt
methods.description: Relays the node response unchanged for one 0x-prefixed 32-byte transaction hash. Unknown hashes return null. submitted carries rung, txHash and nonce; receipted adds the decoded signed receipt, signing key and execution outputs; committed also includes blockNumber and blockHash for the covering MsgSequenceBatch. Quantities are 0x-prefixed hexadecimal strings. Receipt consistency and signature checks do not establish signing authority without pinned receipt keys. The node may refuse with -32000 when the method is served only by a sequencer.

methods.name: px_resolveAccount

params.name: account
params.description: EVM or explicit DID lookup selector retained from the original lookup; layerx_account is a separate native reference and cannot be used for reverse resolution.

methods.description: Resolves EVM address and LayerX DID aliases for one account on the merged Paxeer network (chain 125). These lookup selectors do not identify separate running execution networks. The argument is either a 0x-prefixed 20-byte EVM address or an explicit LayerX DID (did:layerx:<64 hex>). The result is {evm_address, pax_address, layerx_did, layerx_account, bound}: every field comes from the addr precompile's getUnifiedAccount/getEvmAddrByLayerX, the halves that are not bound are null, and bound is false when the EVM address carries no LayerX DID. A bare 64-hex native account identifier is refused with -32001 and data.code=native_account_reverse_resolution_unsupported; it is never reinterpreted as a DID public key. Retain the original EVM/DID lookup selector for repeated account, balance and history reads; layerx_account is a separate native reference. Conflicting forward/reverse joins refuse with data.code=conflicting_identity_binding. An unconfigured Paxeer endpoint is -32001 with data.code=paxeer_rpc_not_configured.

methods.name: px_getAccount

params.name: account
params.description: EVM or explicit DID lookup selector retained from the original lookup; layerx_account is a separate native reference and cannot be used for reverse resolution.

methods.description: Reads account resolution, EVM balance and nonce from chain state at one height returned by eth_blockNumber. The result is {account, paxeer:{address, balance, nonce, height}}; paxeer is null for an account without an EVM binding. No kernel backend is required.

methods.name: px_getBalances

params.name: account
params.description: EVM or explicit DID lookup selector retained from the original lookup; layerx_account is a separate native reference and cannot be used for reverse resolution.

methods.description: Reads the bound EVM address coin list from bank all_balances(address), with account resolution and every eth_call pinned to one height returned by eth_blockNumber. The result is {account, height, balances:[{denom, amount}]}; amounts are exact decimal strings of on-chain 256-bit values. No kernel backend is required.

methods.name: px_listAssets
methods.description: Lists indexer assets sorted by asset_id, limited to 16. Bank denoms read name, symbol, decimals and supply from bank 0x1001; ledger assets read getAsset at 0x101A. Successful ledger reads also include paused (boolean) and verification (authenticated_committed_snapshot). All chain reads use the returned height. A failed or unsupported asset read leaves name, symbol, decimals and supply null and omits paused and verification. Supply is an integer in base units rendered as a decimal string. Takes no arguments.

methods.name: px_getNetwork
methods.description: Network head: network_id and paxeer {chain_id, latest_block} from eth_chainId and eth_blockNumber, beside consensus {latest_height, latest_block_hash, latest_app_hash, catching_up} from the consensus status method. latest_height is a decimal string; hashes retain the consensus hexadecimal encoding. When the consensus endpoint is unset, unreachable, or returns an invalid response, consensus is null and reason is consensus_unavailable; the Paxeer chain ID and latest block still answer. Takes no arguments.

methods.name: px_getHistory

params.name: account
params.description: A Paxeer EVM address, or an explicit DID resolved to its bound EVM address through addr 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001004; an unbound DID is refused with -32602.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous page: the indexer's 32-lowercase-hex (blockHeight, txIndex, logIndex) position cursor, passed through unchanged; null or absent for the first page. Any other form, including the 112-hex form, is refused with -32602.

params.name: kind
params.description: Only rows of this indexer kind, for example native_transfer, erc20_transfer, pointer_transfer or bank_transfer.

id.description: The indexer row id; rows are ordered by (blockHeight, txIndex, logIndex).

height_or_seq.description: The LayerX sequence or Paxeer block height of the row.

chain.description: The chain that recorded the row.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in the asset's base units.

final.description: True once the row is below its chain's finalized boundary.

final_basis.description: Provenance of the indexer stability classification; this does not imply verified settlement.

settlement.description: The indexer has no verified checkpoint evidence for this row. Stability alone is not settlement.

decoded.description: The indexer's decoded payload for the row.

asset_metadata.description: The row's asset joined from the indexer's /v1/assets record and the LayerX asset registry, or null when the indexer has no record of the asset.

asset.description: The indexer asset label: 64-hex LayerX asset id, evm:native, evm:<address> or denom:<denom>.

kind.description: The indexer asset kind: layerx, native, erc20, pointer, bank or tokenfactory.

address.description: The EVM contract address for erc20 and pointer assets.

denom.description: The Cosmos denom for bank, tokenfactory and pointer assets.

symbol.description: The indexer metadata symbol, else the LayerX registry symbol of the asset (by asset id) or of its denom; null when neither declares one.

decimals.description: The indexer metadata decimals, else the LayerX registry decimals, else 18 for the EVM native coin; null when nothing declares them.

native_id.description: The LayerX asset id this asset is, or that the registry maps its denom to.

pointer.description: The EVM pointer contract address when the asset is a pointer.

metadata.description: The indexer's own metadata document for the asset.

blockHeight.description: The block height of the row's position.

txIndex.description: The transaction index of the row's position.

logIndex.description: The log index of the row's position.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash, exactly equal to tx_id.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next older page, or null when this page is the last.

indexedHeight.description: The Paxeer height the indexer has indexed (indexer freshness); null before the first indexed block.

chainHeight.description: The Paxeer head height eth_blockNumber answers.

methods.description: The indexed transfer history of one Paxeer EVM address, newest first, from the layerx-indexer read API: native, ERC-20, pointer, bank, tokenfactory and custody rows, each joined with asset_metadata. Cursors are the indexer's, passed through unchanged. An address the indexer has never seen answers an empty page.

methods.description: One history for the whole unified account: the account is resolved as px_resolveAccount does and the indexer pages of its EVM address and of each of its LayerX accounts are merged newest first in the indexer's row order, each row tagged with side and carrying its chain and asset_metadata. Every side is read at the same cursor, so next_cursor is the indexer row cursor of the last row returned and pages chain without gaps or repeats.

methods.name: px_getCapabilities

exchange.description: True when eth_call of totalMarkets() at the exchange precompile 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001015 decodes as the view's uint256 return value; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

bridge.description: True when eth_call of isPaused() at the bridge precompile 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001016 decodes as the view's bool return value; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

launchpad.description: True when eth_call of getPoolCount() at the launchpad precompile 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001017 decodes as the view's uint256 return value; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

ledger.description: True when eth_call of accountId(bytes32,bytes32) at the ledger precompile 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101a using two zero bytes32 arguments decodes as the view's bytes32 return value; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

pay.description: True when eth_call of budgetRemaining(bytes32) at the pay precompile 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101b using a zero bytes32 argument decodes as the view's uint128 return value; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

auth.description: True when eth_call of isLive(bytes32,uint64,uint64) at the auth precompile 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101c using a zero bytes32 and two zero uint64 arguments decodes as the view's bool and string return values; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

programs.description: True when eth_call of getCurrentFeeSchedule() at the programs precompile 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101d decodes as the view's uint32, uint64[7] and bytes32 return values; false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value.

probed_at.description: Unix seconds at which the gateway took the probe.

rpc_height.description: The Paxeer block height, as a decimal string, at which every probe call was made.

methods.description: Which Paxeer X fork surfaces the chain answers for. The gateway reads eth_blockNumber and then uses eth_call at that height to probe each precompile's view: exchange at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001015 with totalMarkets(), bridge at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001016 with isPaused(), launchpad at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001017 with getPoolCount(), ledger at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101a with accountId(bytes32,bytes32) using two zero bytes32 arguments, pay at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101b with budgetRemaining(bytes32) using a zero bytes32 argument, auth at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101c with isLive(bytes32,uint64,uint64) using a zero bytes32 and two zero uint64 arguments, and programs at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000101d with getCurrentFeeSchedule(). A surface is true when the answer decodes as its view's return value, and false when the call reverts or answers a malformed value, including an empty answer. The answer is cached for LAYERX_GATEWAY_CAPABILITIES_TTL_SECONDS (default 15). While a surface is false, eth_sendRawTransaction and eth_sendRawTransactionSync addressed to its precompile are refused with -32003 Surface unavailable and data {code: surface_unavailable, surface, address}; reads and history are never gated. Takes no arguments.

methods.name: px_getRouteCatalogue
methods.summary: Authenticated product route catalogue and dependency readiness.

canonical_origin.description: Public root-node origin; this does not locate the hosted gateway.

node_rpc.description: Chain 125 node JSON-RPC is served at this origin and root path.

hosted_gateway.description: Obtain hosted gateway coordinates and credentials from its operator. These paths are relative to that gateway, not node_rpc.origin; px_* availability at public node URLs is not implied.

methods.description: Returns the authenticated route catalogue for the merged Paxeer network (chain 125), with separate node_rpc and hosted_gateway locations. Public node JSON-RPC uses the root path; hosted px_* JSON-RPC uses POST / at operator-provided gateway coordinates, and authenticated HTTP discovery uses GET /v1/routes there. The unified /rpc interface and its subtree are retired and omitted from discovery. Readiness reports dependency health and identity checks; route entries describe request contracts and do not establish successful end-to-end feature execution or hosted API deployment at public node URLs.
